question: Should OpenClaw publish a versioned OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic clients, and which Gateway HTTP/RPC/plugin surfaces should it cover?
rationale: Current main exposes documented APIs, but OpenAPI publication would freeze a stronger external contract for auth, paths, versioning, and upgrade behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design Supported Contract First
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose the schema scope, versioning model, exposure path, and security notes before implementation.

options.title: Limit To Existing Docs
options.body: Decline OpenAPI for now and keep Gateway protocol docs plus TypeBox/draft-07 schema generation as the supported client-generation path.

options.title: Prototype Outside Core
options.body: Explore a plugin or external generator first if maintainers want demand proof without committing core to a broad schema surface.

recommendation.title: Design Supported Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose the schema scope, versioning model, exposure path, and security notes before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest direct history signal for prior OpenAPI/config-schema artifact work and related Gateway HTTP API implementation.
